blob: {"Id":"FR-MCP-115","Title":"Session and compaction hook output schema compliance","Body":"MCP plugin session and compaction hooks SHALL emit schema-valid hook outputs for their event type. Status-only SessionStart, SessionEnd, PreCompact, and PostCompact outcomes SHALL emit an empty JSON object; hooks that emit hookSpecificOutput SHALL include the matching hookEventName and only fields supported by that event. PostCompact SHALL NOT emit additionalContext because that event cannot inject context.","WorkspaceId":"F:\\GitHub\\McpServer","Priority":"medium","Status":"pending","Notes":null,"AcceptanceCriteria":[{"id":"","text":"SessionStart, SessionEnd, PreCompact, and PostCompact status-only hook scripts emit {} instead of non-spec hookSpecificOutput status payloads.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Hook Bats suites assert exact {} output for the affected session and compact hooks."},{"id":"","text":"PostCompact does not emit additionalContext.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Hook Bats suites assert post-compact output is {} and does not contain additionalContext."}],"ScopeStartLayerKey":"layer-1","ScopeEndLayerKey":null,"LinkedUseCases":[]}

{"Id":"FR-MCP-FAILSAFE-001","Title":"Failsafe drain treats 503 backend_unavailable as backend-down and can retry","Body":"Session-log persist that hits the storage budget or a transient provider fault stays retryable HTTP 503 backend_unavailable with failsafe on disk. Drain aborts without incrementing drainAttempts or quarantining. After storage answers, a later drain in the same process can replay. BUG-TRIAGE-159.
- [ ] Submit/append still returns retryable backend_unavailable and keeps failsafe YAML
- [ ] Test-ReplFailsafeBackendUnreachable treats HTTP 503 and code backend_unavailable as unreachable
- [ ] Drain does not latch failed=1 as permanently completed in-process","WorkspaceId":"F:\GitHub\McpServer","Priority":"medium","Status":"pending","Notes":null,"AcceptanceCriteria":[],"ScopeStartLayerKey":"layer-1","ScopeEndLayerKey":null,"LinkedUseCases":[]}

{"Id":"FR-MCP-MEMORY-007","Title":"Agent plugin memory integration","Body":"Official McpServer agent plugins SHALL expose memory tools and SHALL inject the `REQUIRED MEMORIES` block at host-supported request boundaries, or SHALL document a host limitation and expose an explicit memory-list fallback.","WorkspaceId":"F:\\GitHub\\McpServer","Priority":"medium","Status":"pending","Notes":null,"AcceptanceCriteria":[{"id":"","text":"Codex, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Copilot, Grok, Cline v1, Cline v2, and OpenCode plugin lanes validate memory tool availability.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Shell plugin Bats memory tests and TypeScript memory tests."},{"id":"","text":"Plugins with request-boundary injection hooks render REQUIRED MEMORIES on every supported user prompt boundary.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Plugin validation and marker memory injection coverage."},{"id":"","text":"Plugins without a usable request-boundary injection hook document the host limitation without claiming automatic injection.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Plugin docs and validation expectations."},{"id":"","text":"Plugin validation identifies the host hook or fallback, workspace marker path, and example REQUIRED MEMORIES output.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Plugin validation coverage."},{"id":"","text":"Plugin memory mutations append session-log actions and clear local failsafe entries after server acknowledgement.","isSatisfied":true,"evidence":"Shell Bats and TypeScript memory tests for mutation action append and failsafe cleanup."}],"ScopeStartLayerKey":"layer-1","ScopeEndLayerKey":null,"LinkedUseCases":[]}

{"Id":"FR-MCP-REPL-009","Title":"Degraded session-log persistence isolation","Body":"The MCP REPL SHALL isolate plugins from MCP Session Log service degradation during session and in-progress turn operations. When a turn closes while the primary service is degraded, the REPL SHALL durably persist the complete turn through an independent failsafe strategy and SHALL notify the caller with the failsafe path.","WorkspaceId":"F:\\GitHub\\McpServer","Priority":"critical","Status":"pending","Notes":null,"AcceptanceCriteria":[{"id":"FR-MCP-REPL-009-AC001","text":"Open, begin, update, appendDialog, and appendActions remain successful when primary MCP Session Log persistence fails but failsafe persistence succeeds.","isSatisfied":false,"evidence":null},{"id":"FR-MCP-REPL-009-AC002","text":"The failsafe artifact contains a replayable session-log persistence envelope including the attempted turn data and status.","isSatisfied":false,"evidence":null},{"id":"FR-MCP-REPL-009-AC003","text":"completeTurn and failTurn report degraded persistence, the independent strategy name, and the absolute failsafe path without claiming primary MCP persistence succeeded.","isSatisfied":false,"evidence":null},{"id":"FR-MCP-REPL-009-AC004","text":"Primary persistence success produces no pending failsafe artifact and reports normal MCP persistence.","isSatisfied":false,"evidence":null}],"ScopeStartLayerKey":"layer-1","ScopeEndLayerKey":null,"LinkedUseCases":[]}

{"Id":"FR-MCP-REPL-011","Title":"Plugin failsafe queue drains instead of accumulating","Body":"BUG-TRIAGE-097. The MCP plugin PowerShell runtime writes every session-log submit to a failsafe queue on disk before calling the backend, so a crash or an unreachable server cannot lose the turn. Until now nothing ever replayed those records: the queue only grew, and plugin Status reported pendingCount 0 while captured turns sat undrained (33 records in F:/GitHub/McpServer as of 2026-07-20, oldest 2026-07-14, eight added in a single session). An agent or operator MUST be able to get queued turns into the session log once the backend is reachable again, automatically on the first proven-reachable call and on demand through an explicit drain verb, without ever losing a record: a record leaves the queue only after its submission is confirmed, a record the backend rejects does not block the newer records behind it, and a record that cannot be replayed at all is set aside for inspection rather than deleted or retried forever. Plugin Status MUST report the real queue depth.","WorkspaceId":"F:\\GitHub\\McpServer","Priority":"medium","Status":"pending","Notes":null,"AcceptanceCriteria":[],"ScopeStartLayerKey":"layer-1","ScopeEndLayerKey":null,"LinkedUseCases":[]}
